feeds.title: Washingtonian
feeds.description: The Washingtonian Magazine is the online presence of Washingtonian Magazine, a monthly lifestyle publication covering the Washington D.C. metropolitan area. The website features articles on topics such as food and drink, travel, arts and culture, real estate, and politics, with a focus on events and happenings in and around the nation's capital.

feeds.title: Eater DC
feeds.description: Eater DC is a food news and dining guides for Washington, DC.

feeds.title: KidFriendly DC
feeds.description: KidFriendly DC is the go-to resource for the scoop on the best recreation, events, entertainment, and activities with kids in the Washington, DC-Metro area. From the tried and true to the new and cool, find out where to go and what to do with the kiddos in the nation's capital.

feeds.title: DC Theater Arts
feeds.description: DC Theater Arts has played a key role in the Washington, DC area performing arts community. Through reviews, feature articles and interviews, news stories, and opinion pieces, we provide our readers with comprehensive coverage of the local and regional performing arts scene.

feeds.title: Washington Monthly
feeds.description: The Washington Monthly was founded in 1969 on the notion that a handful of plucky young writers and editors, armed with an honest desire to make government work and a willingness to ask uncomfortable questions, could tell the story of what really matters in Washington better than a roomful of Beltway insiders at a Georgetown dinner party.

feeds.title: The Washington Lobbyist

feeds.title: Visme Visual Learning Center.
feeds.description: We give you easy (and powerful) tools to manage and empower your online presence. We provide users with a user-friendly, simple method to create and edit powerful presentations and infographics right in their browsers.

feeds.title: DC Sports King
feeds.description: King of DC Sports covers news, rumors of the Washington Commanders, Wizards, Nationals, Capitals, Maryland Terrapins, Georgetown Hoyas, and more.

feeds.title: Have Camera Will Travel
feeds.description: Cherry Blossom Watch brings together information about visiting the cherry blossoms and Washington DC, peak bloom forecasts, and up-to-date photos to help you make the most of your own visit or follow along from afar. Up-to-date peak bloom forecasts, news, information, & photos of Washington DC's cherry blossoms.

feeds.title: Blonde in the District Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Blonde in the District, an award winning Washington DC & Virginia life, style, beauty, and travel blog dedicated to body positivity and encouraging women to find their confidence through style.

feeds.title: Ghosts of DC

A Touch of Teal is truly Katie Urban's passion project where she share the things she love, reflect on past and present experiences, and document her life.

feeds.title: DC Theatre Scene - Washington's liveliest theatre website
feeds.description: DC Theatre Scene is a Web site which covers professional theatre in the greater Washington DC area, with occasional looks at theatre in Baltimore, Philadelphia and NYC. Find listings and ticket discounts, read reviews and news, learn about the performers and producers which make the DC area theatre scene one of the most vibrant and important communities in the country.

feeds.title: Alicia Tenise

Alicia like to focus on all things attainable, Alicia show you what you should invest in and what to save on to make the most out of your wardrobe, home decor, and vacations.

feeds.title: Capitol Standard
feeds.description: Covers strategies to elevate your career, your money and your life. Browse curated professional networks, insider events list, and city guides. Capitol Standard is fueling career growth, and redefining the standards of success for corporate professionals everywhere.

feeds.title: The DC Darlings
feeds.description: Welcome to the DC darlings! We are best friends, living in the Nation's Capitol, and we believe life is too short not to be fabulous. Follow us for the latest trends in fashion & beauty, as we share with you our favorite spots throughout the DC Metropolitan Area. We hope to bring you the best of the Washington, and anywhere else the world may take us.
